steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Chief, we've stalled it from the front! The good news is, this Apostle's attack power is a lot lower than expected. The bad news is, is that it's just too resilient! There is no end in sight for this battle!

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: The battle time has already exceeded our original plan. You should take everyone and leave. After all, OwO is an ordinary girl. If she stays in the Mania field for too long...
An Apostle minion suddenly breaks through the line of defense and dashes toward OwO.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hey! Stay back! OwO's lion head will bite! Watch this... ahh!
The director yanks her back from behind. At the same time, the little blue critter suddenly jumps in front of OwO and lets out a long, silent cry.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Why is Stella acting like this... Something's also wrong with the enemies around us...
There's a brief silence, as if the battle had been paused. Then, the Apostle's minions suddenly start screaming, and the attacks become more frenzied.
Did the little critter make them go crazy?

steps.speaker: Rabbo
steps.content:
Quack quack! Quack quack quack quack quack quack!
(Its main body has left! It's been repelled!! Quick, after it! Don't let it get away!)

steps.speaker: Timecop Duck
steps.content:
Quack!
(Yes, sir!)
Before leaving, the strange ducks salute you, but you have no idea what they're saying.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Chief! The Apostle's main body suddenly left. It stopped attacking and vanished from the battlefield. The remaining minions are probably attacking harder to cover its retreat. Their strength has obviously weakened.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Is Stella protecting OwO?
...You have something more important on your mind than this naive guess.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What distinguishes it from other clones is not just its strength. Its power is clearly not concretization. Then...
But now, you must end this battle as quickly as possible. There's too much chaos. Even with the Hyperpyramid's protection, an ordinary kid like OwO shouldn't stay any longer.
You decide to make the Sinners stay and clear the scene, and ask the director to...

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: Bye! We non-combatants are leaving now! Carry on, everyone!
She had already put on her coat and started fleeing like the wind with OwO under her arm.
The corridor to the gate of the theater isn't long, but OwO's struggles slowed them down.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Ahhh... No, no, no! We're so close! Stella's still not back home, and we haven't filmed the climax yet! I don't want to go!

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: There, there. Didn't we already get a lot from this trip? Let's go back and review what we have.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: The DisCars are just an inch away! Let go of me!

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: Ugh, those are worthless. If you really want one, ask ${PlayerName} to pay a bribe, and you'll...

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: ...Uh-oh.
She doesn't stop in time and stumbles out the broken gate. They instantly get overwhelmed by blinding camera flashes and snapping camera shutters.

steps.speaker: Cacophonous Crowd
steps.content: They're out, they're out!

steps.speaker: Cacophonous Crowd
steps.content: I knew it was her! I recognized her right away! That reporter was talking about it earlier!

steps.speaker: Cacophonous Crowd
steps.content: That blue monster is gone... so it has been killed! Did she go up close to film it? What a thrilling topic! We expect nothing less from her!
The people blocking the gate aren't soldiers, but a blur of glamorous folks all surging forward with their cameras.
OwO suddenly remembers that this is the first image of the DisCars she's ever seen. The red carpet, the theater, the flashing lights, the screaming crowds... It's a dreamy, surreal sight to behold.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: ...The DisCars? Am I at the DisCars already?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Are they all here to see me? Director, did our film get a lot of attention?
The crowd shrieks, and the white-clad guards in front fail to hold them back. All the spotlight is focused on the other person—the "director" who's concealing herself with a hat and heavy coat.

steps.speaker: Excited Crowd
steps.content:
It's Deren!!!
Deren is back in Dillywood!!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Huh?
